scope: beta-only, operator-governed self-signed CSCA certificate ceremony using an existing active KMS-backed issuer profile

public_route.operator_claim_source: Gateway injects SIGNING_KEYS_CSCA_ISSUE_GATEWAY_KEY and trusted x-user-id only after authenticating an operator for the tenant; Signing Keys requires that distinct key and SIGNING_KEYS_BETA_CSCA_ISSUANCE_ENABLED=true in ENVIRONMENT=beta

authority: Resolve exactly one active tenant issuer profile with purpose csca, format ICAO_EMRTD, and algorithm ES256. Derive its signing key reference and current public key from the profile and KMS. The caller cannot supply a KMS locator, CSR, certificate, signature, or private key.

certificate.csr: Sign a server-built bounded C/O/CN CSR through the profile-scoped KMS method; verify proof of possession and require its SPKI to match the current KMS public key.
certificate.serial: fresh positive unpredictable 16-byte value for every new ceremony
certificate.extensions: X.509 v3 with critical CA basic constraints, pathLen=0, and keyCertSign usage
certificate.validity: 1 to 3650 whole days from server time, without silent truncation
certificate.signature: Sign DER TBS through the same profile-scoped KMS method and verify the self-signature against the current KMS public key before lifecycle enrollment
certificate.private_key_custody: KMS only; no private key generation, import, export, serialization, or response field

concurrency.retry: certificate_id is a tenant-scoped idempotency key; a full-request digest in the immutable lifecycle record returns the same historical public result on an identical retry, including after a lost response or later profile rotation; changed input conflicts
concurrency.rotation: Hold the tenant signing lease, re-read the active profile and current KMS public key after signing, then use the lifecycle revision CAS for enrollment; reject changed identity or key without publication
concurrency.failure: Any failed authorization, validation, KMS, signature, or fence check leaves the lifecycle unchanged

cases.name: valid_beta_csca
cases.result: issue and enroll one self-signed KMS-backed CSCA

cases.name: same_certificate_id_retry
cases.result: return identical historical public certificate without signing
